propositions: The bridge noun and nested subcommand dispatch must ship with only preview and sync verbs functional, deferring setup, check-access, fsck, status, pause, and resume to dependent stories.
Legacy top-level commands (reconcile, jira-onboard, bridge-probe, bridge-fsck, rebar doctor) must remain fully functional with no breakage to existing workflows, scripts, or library callers.
Bridge preview enforces dry-run mode and performs no mutations to Jira or ticket store; bridge sync enforces live mode and mutates persisted state.
Mode.py, MODE_CAPS, and the gated_mode value reconcile-check must survive intact for MCP surface and phase-gate compatibility.
The bridge noun dispatch group must never fall through to top-level commands; group help and unknown-verb behavior must be explicit.
Generated user guide, CLI reference, and release notes must document only the staged surface that ships (preview and sync) while explicitly preserving legacy command vocabulary.
